document.title: Phase 4: XSLT 4.0
document.p: Goal (PLAN.md): XSLT 4.0 templates, modes and minimal packages, lowered into the shared IR (, ) and run by the one evaluator; sxml transform (docs/CLI.md). Gate: 70% of the in-scope XSLT 4.0 test cases pass (; in scope: spec XSLT40, not the strm and sandp groups, no schema_aware, streaming, dtd, XML_1.1, XSD_1.1, backwards_compatibility, HTML4 or ICU_spellout feature; about 8,700 cases). Rules for parallel packets are those of docs/tasks/phase-2.md (, ).

section.title: Overlap with Phases 2 and 3 ()
section.p: Packets marked Early may start once the Phase 1 gate is closed and their "After" list is committed, during Phases 2 and 3; they own no file of a running packet. Early: 4.0, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5. The others wait for the Phase 3 gate (they need XQuery's constructors, try/catch, serializers and API, and must not race its sweeps for files).

section.title: How XSLT lowers (src/ir_internal.h)
section.p: The stylesheet is parsed by sxml's XML parser into an arena tree, read into a stylesheet AST (4.2) and lowered by XSLT lowering parts (2.1): instructions as XQuery (xsl:variable LET, xsl:for-each MAP, xsl:sort SORT, xsl:choose CONDITIONAL, literal result elements and xsl:element the constructor kinds, xsl:copy SHALLOW_COPY, xsl:try TRY_CATCH); XPath in attributes through the embedding entry of 2.1 with each element's static context; template rules as the named extension point (modes, rules, match functions from patterns, APPLY_TEMPLATES), as src/ir_internal.h writes out. No new IR kind; a packet that needs one writes "Proposed".

section.title: Parallelism plan

row.cell: 4.9 sorting and grouping, 4.10 keys and XSLT functions, 4.11 numbering and analyze-string, 4.12 functions and declarations

section.p: Critical path: 4.2 4.5 4.6 4.8 4.13 4.15 4.17 4.18. "Working XSLT" for the owner is the end of 4.15: sxml transform runs the insn-apply-templates, for-each-group, sort, key and number tests.

item.p: 4.19 XSLT conformance sweep (implementation). Owns the XSLT lowering and reader files it changes (src/xslt_*), their unit tests, and single insertions in the ledgers. In order of value: the "~T" type patterns of priority (only if the suite's draft is the project's, ), xsl:item-type and xsl:record-type (), merge, fn:snapshot, extension instructions as template calls (10.1.3), an index for match="$var" membership, the module named by errors in included modules, the larger duplicates of . Done when each item is done or its cause is recorded, with before and after counts of the affected sets. Done 2026-10-19 (): XT40 8,650 to 8,759 passed, 0 errors; call-template-ext 32/32, record 39/47, type-alias 25/32, snapshot 34/35, merge 79/120 (29 streaming), collection 5/6; priority unchanged (the "~T" patterns are not in the project's draft, ). Errors in included modules name their module; one array allocation helper. Left: the match="$var" index (), the record constructor, XTDE3490, the group key equality.

The drafts are those of 13 October 2026 (qtspecs 72f2229), the suite is 91328fb; the draft has no type patterns, so 57 cases stay recorded as class (b) (53 "~T", 4 priorities, 2 patterns the draft allows). New from the draft: typed="~T" on xsl:mode (6.9.4, XTTE3100). XT40 11,945 to 11,951 passed (+130 wrong error), 0 errors, no case lost; the six from 7.20.
